Accepted Strategic Games Topic Catalog

Canonical folder topic: strategic_games

Subtopics

  • strategic_games.core - strategic games, profiles, deviations, best responses, and dominance primitives.
  • strategic_games.equilibrium - Nash equilibrium and seed examples such as Prisoner's Dilemma.

Boundary

Use strategic_games, not strategic_game, for new ids and references.
